name: Newhaven, Spell Shop
desc1: This dimly lit room is one of the strangest that you have seen. The
desc2: walls are decorated with bizarre ornaments ranging from elaborate
desc3: tapestries to stuffed orc heads. A wizened old man cloaked in strange
desc4: garb sits behind a small counter, apparently murmuring to himself. You
desc5: can exit through the curtained doorway to the south.
